cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C1: Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) buffered by prominent Coco-Betaine (3); no reinforcing anionic. Counter-signals toward low: prominent payload lipids Glycine Soja Oil (6) and Dicaprylyl Ether (13), glycerin (5), two cationic polymers; they lower confidence to moderate (neighbor low), not the value.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High by C2 with a payload-lipid substitute: prominent nonvolatile Glycine Soja Oil (6) takes the early-silicone place, plus cationic polymers Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (19) and Polyquaternium-7 (22), pearlizing route Glycol Distearate (4), humectant Glycerin (5); Dicaprylyl Ether (13) adds emollience. Counter-signal toward moderate: polymers sit late (after Propylene Glycol 18), oil is liquid not waxy; confidence moderate.

excluded: PEG-55 Propylene Glycol Oleate (11), PPG-5-Ceteth-20 (10): PEG/PPG thickeners/solubilizers (C3, 6.4)
Oryza Sativa Starch (9): starch/absorbent, not substantive
Avena Sativa Kernel Extract (8): botanical extract

depositionLoad.rationale: Prominent soybean oil plus dicaprylyl ether converging with two cationic polymers (W-RICH formally established), but polymers are late and oil is liquid.

persistence.rationale: Liquid oil and ether are less substantive than waxy lipids (6.4); PQ-7/guar at low positions; no silicone.

resetCapacity.rationale: C1 SLES/betaine chassis is an effective ordinary reset, not limited.

weightPotential.counterevidence: W-RICH holds (prominent payload lipid + cationic system) and points toward high; liquid oil, late polymers and an effective SLES reset point away from it.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Converging lipid and cationic routes plausibly leave noticeable but bounded residue; reset is ordinary.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: the high anchor needs W-RICH with limited reset; here reset is an effective SLES/betaine chassis, the lipid is a liquid oil and both polymers sit after position 18, so a heavy/coating conclusion is not supported. Not low: prominent soybean oil plus two cationic polymers are plausible enough that lightweight would understate residue (W2).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Oil and polymer levels unknown; a richer level could move it to high.
weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: rich-leaning lipid + cationic architecture offset by ordinary SLES reset and late, light-persistence routes.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Several manufacturer E2 sensitive units ('beruhigend auf die juckende Kopfhaut', 'sensible Kopfhaut', 'Erleichterung bei juckender Kopfhaut', SC1 moderate) over a credible supportive architecture: comfort route Avena Sativa Kernel Extract (8), Glycerin (5), refatting Soybean Oil (6), fragrance last, no menthol/essential oils. dandruffSupport.rationale: No Piroctone Olamine or Climbazole; Salicylic Acid (26) does not qualify (Section 11).

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W moderate, C high: fine acceptable, normal ideal, coarse ideal. Sensitive target; no not_suited so T6 lifts nothing. T4: normal ideal -> W neighbor high gives acceptable -> flag normal. Coarse ideal -> C neighbor moderate gives acceptable -> flag coarse. Fine acceptable -> W neighbor high gives not_suited, lifted by T6 -> no flag.
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-SENSITIVE: positioning manufacturer E2 sensitive units (moderate); formula scalpComfortTarget targeted and prominent E4 comfort route Avena Sativa Kernel Extract (8) -> pass. cleansingStrength moderate, so no review_strong_cleansing_comfort_route. No dry, oily or dandruff unit. Confidence = min(positioning moderate, scalpComfortTarget high) -> moderate.
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1 moderate -> regular. irritationen expects gentle, so rows are amber (I2). I3: current intensity already differs from the bucket expectation -> no flag (neighbor low would match, which is the non-flag direction).
